name: pi-desktop
description: Visual desktop client for the pi coding agent (Electron + React, Kimi theme)
author: pi-desktop contributors

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && node scripts/test-plugins.mjs && node scripts/test-mcp.mjs && node scripts/test-provider.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.dist: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && npm run build:runtime && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && npm run build:runtime && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && npm run build:runtime && electron-builder --win
